shared_elements: shallow carved curvilinear motifs on a natural rock surface
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, schematic incised/relief motifs on unshaped natural rock, and A's boulder appears to bear a faint curvilinear, possibly face-like design that is broadly comparable in reductive convention to B's stick-figure and wavy line. However, B shows a clearly legible scene — a small human figure with raised arms beside a long undulating serpentine band and an isolated dot — while nothing in A is identifiable as a figure, an animal or a repeated wave, so no specific motif or relationship can be matched.
